jobs.occupation: KYC Analyst - Temp mission of 3 months - Brussels - M/F/X
jobs.description:
Our client is an international Fintech present in many countries around the world and having its HQ in Brussels.

Jobomschrijving

As a KYC Analyst your responsibilities are:

• Review and verify client documentation to ensure compliance with KYC requirements
• Maintain and update client records in line with regulatory standards
• Conduct due diligence on new and existing clients
• Identify and report any discrepancies or risks in client documentation

jobs.occupation: Project Support Officer - SAP & Document Control
jobs.description:
📋 Tasks and responsibilities

For a project engineering team in Olen, we are looking for a well-organised Project Administrative Assistant / Project Support Officer to provide day-to-day administrative support in a technical project environment.

This role is focused on operational project administration, with emphasis on purchasing support, SAP follow-up, time registration processing, document control and coordination with internal stakeholders and external EPCM partners. The position is primarily administrative and does not require an engineering background.

• Follow up purchasing activities, purchase orders and invoices in SAP and SAP Ariba.
• Verify timecards and process time registrations in SAP for project staff and external partners.
• Coordinate administrative activities with internal teams and EPCM partners.
• Manage project documentation, including As Built files, folder structures and information flows.
• Prepare planning overviews, monitor action lists and follow up on missing input.
• Collect, register, analyse and verify project-related information in systems such as SAP and Planisware.
• Support the project team with meetings, minutes, communication, travel arrangements and backup administrative assistance.
Location

The assignment is based on site in Olen.

Full on-site presence is required during onboarding and training to become familiar with the team, systems and internal processes. After a successful onboarding period, remote work may be possible in agreement with the manager.

• You have at least 5 years of relevant experience in administrative support, project administration, purchasing support or project support.
• You have experience working in a technical project environment.
• You understand purchase orders, invoices, approval flows and administrative processes in practice.
• You have experience with Document Management Systems; knowledge of SharePoint is a strong plus.
• You are comfortable with Microsoft Office, especially Outlook, SharePoint, Word and Excel.
• Experience with SAP is a strong advantage; SAP Ariba is a plus.
• You work accurately with administrative data, time registrations, purchase-order information and invoice details.
• You are practical, hands-on and service-oriented.
• You are well organised and able to handle multiple administrative priorities at the same time.
• You are detail-oriented, reliable and attentive to project priorities.
• You take ownership and follow up tasks until completion.
• You proactively request missing input, monitor actions and escalate when needed.
• You communicate clearly and professionally with internal and external stakeholders.
• You feel comfortable in an international, multidisciplinary project environment.
• You are a team player who can also work independently within agreed procedures.
• Experience working according to documented procedures, approval workflows and audit-trail requirements is considered an asset.
• You are fluent in Dutch, both spoken and written.
• You are fluent in English, both spoken and written.

This company moves over 250 orders a day from  730 suppliers in EAME to over 72 facilities all over the world.

Jobomschrijving

Do you have a bachelor’s degree? Are you an analytical thinker with strong communication skills? Can you express yourself clearly, both orally and in writing, in English and Dutch? If so, you could be the Junior Logistics Planning Analyst we’re looking for!

Within the Global Parts Supply (GPS) team, working with suppliers is key. As a GPS team member, you are the vital link between suppliers and customers, managing all supplier communications. The mission is to maintain a healthy supply chain and prevent shortages that could lead to customer back orders. On a daily basis, you liaise with suppliers, drive accountability for their results, and work toward challenging but achievable goals that ensure superior service levels.

As a Logistics Planning Analyst, you are responsible to establish solid business relationships with a set of defined suppliers: 

• Focus on timely and quality deliveries to the distribution center, ensuring parts are available for the end customer.
• Educate and hold suppliers accountable to achieve challenging business results.
• Value teamwork and collaborate with key partners such as transportation, procurement, and engineering as needed.
• To be successful, you will need to develop and master a thorough understanding of our supply chain processes and systems.
Responsibilities may include, but are not limited to:

• Monitor schedules to ensure punctual and efficient shipments with suppliers.
• Track supplier performance and implement corrective actions when necessary.
• Maintain strong communication and positive relationships with both internal divisions and external suppliers.
• Evaluate and challenge supplier results based on the supplier performance standard.
• Analyze and correct data irregularities.
• Provide thorough support on high priority back orders.

The Junior Logistics Planning Analyst we are looking for has the following skills:

• Minimum Master’s degree with a strong link to Supply Chain, Logistics Management, Production, and Logistics or Transport.
• Strong attention to detail.
• Analytical mindset.
• Fluent written and oral skills in English and Dutch are required, French or German is a plus.
• Motivated to work in a target focused area.
• Self-motivated and committed.
• Strong interpersonal skills.

Our client is a well-established global technology and manufacturing organization with over a century of industry expertise. The company develops innovative commercial equipment and intelligent embedded control systems used by businesses and institutions worldwide.

Jobomschrijving

• Design, develop, and maintain embedded firmware using C programming for electronic control systems.
• Develop reliable and efficient software solutions for next-generation embedded products.
• Create and execute test plans and validation activities to ensure product quality and performance.
• Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to validate firmware on prototypes and production units.

jobs.occupation: Join Our Team as an Order Picker Warehouse Associate – Start Immediately in a Dynamic Environment!
jobs.description:
As an order picker warehouse associate, you play a key role in the warehouse operation. You will operate a high-level order picker truck (VNA), allowing you to safely pick products from elevated racks. Using a handheld scanner, you accurately check locations, quantities, and the correctness of orders. Your effort ensures that customers receive the right products on time and keeps the logistics process running smoothly.

On a typical workday, you collect customer orders by picking products from various warehouse locations. You work closely with colleagues, strictly follow safety instructions, and keep your workspace clean. You check products for damage or missing items and report these to the team leader. Packing and preparing orders for shipment is also part of your tasks, ensuring everything is ready to go out to customers efficiently.

Are you physically fit, detail-oriented, and do you enjoy a varied job in logistics? Apply today and make a difference in a close-knit team where collaboration and safety are essential.

• Previous experience as an order picker or warehouse associate is a plus.
• Certificate of good conduct (criminal record certificate) required.
• License or certificate for high-level order picker truck is an advantage.
• English speaking skills at level 3/5 (for effective communication and understanding instructions).
• Good physical fitness: able to stand, walk, and lift up to 17 kg.
• Accurate, responsible, and able to work safely in a fast-paced environment.

Bedrijfsomschrijving 

This company (re)packs and stores frozen and refrigerated food products for numerous European companies. They do this for each customer. By 2027, the company aims to have 300+ employees working on 25 000 unique packaging assignments. Working in this company means working in a respectful environment, where a great bond between employees and dedication to work go hand in hand.

As an operator, you will be responsible for 1 of 2 automatic packaging lines.

 
• 
You carry out checks on the food products that are introduced.

 
• 
You also set various parameters so that the right product ends up in the right packaging.

 
• 
Furthermore, you have to monitor the smooth operation of your packaging line.

 
• 
In case of technical failures, you are the first person who tries to solve this. For major malfunctions, you coordinate with the person in charge.

 
• 
The checks on the finished product are also done by you.

 
• 
All this in a team with a co-operator and 2 forklift drivers.

Read on quickly below and find out if you qualify:

 
• 
You have experience in setting up machines (it is a vertical packaging machine).

 
• 
You have a good technical knowledge.

 
• 
You speak good English and Dutch

 
• 
Experience as a forklift operator or forklift certificate is a plus.

 
• 
You highly value safety.
